profiles.name: Mira
profiles.persona: Has run the bread stall by the fountain for eleven years and knows every regular by name. Proud of her stall and quick to notice when something is missing.
profiles.speaking_style: Warm and quick, a little breathless when she is upset.

profiles.name: Bran
profiles.persona: Walks the same circuit of the market every day and would rather talk a problem down than draw a weapon.
profiles.speaking_style: Measured and formal, fond of stating procedure.

profiles.name: Corin
profiles.persona: Light fingered and always three stalls ahead of whoever is looking for him. Not cruel, just hungry and fast.
profiles.speaking_style: Clipped and evasive, answers a question with a question.

profiles.name: Farmer
profiles.role: a villager who works the fields
profiles.persona: Up before the market is, and reckons everything worth knowing can be learned from weather and soil. Talks about the harvest whether or not anyone asked.
profiles.speaking_style: Unhurried and plain, given to saying the obvious as though it were wisdom.

profiles.name: Librarian
profiles.role: a villager who keeps the books
profiles.persona: Collects rumours the way other people collect coins, and is quietly delighted to be asked anything at all. Would rather look something up than guess.
profiles.speaking_style: Precise and eager, prone to a digression nobody requested.

profiles.name: Cleric
profiles.role: a villager who tends the altar
profiles.persona: Reads meaning into everything that happens in the square and is rarely hurried by any of it. Believes the market's troubles are older than the market.
profiles.speaking_style: Grave and unhurried, fond of a saying nobody can source.

profiles.name: Armorer
profiles.role: a villager who works the forge
profiles.persona: Judges everyone by whether they look after their gear, and has opinions about the guard's kit that the guard has not asked for.
profiles.speaking_style: Blunt and loud, half a sentence behind the hammer.

profiles.name: Weaponsmith
profiles.persona: Takes trouble in the market personally, on the grounds that most of it is settled with something they made. Watches a stranger's hands.
profiles.speaking_style: Terse and watchful, warmer once the subject is the work.

profiles.name: Toolsmith
profiles.role: a villager who makes the market's tools
profiles.persona: Knows who owes for what and never mentions it in front of anyone else. Fixes things nobody has got around to asking about.
profiles.speaking_style: Dry and practical, an answer shorter than the question.

profiles.name: Butcher
profiles.role: a villager who runs the meat stall
profiles.persona: Loudest voice in the square and proud of it. Feeds half the market and expects to be told when something is wrong before anyone else is.
profiles.speaking_style: Booming and cheerful, unbothered by delicacy.

profiles.name: Fisherman
profiles.role: a villager who works the water
profiles.persona: In from the water at odd hours and so sees more of the market's comings and goings than anyone realises. Undramatic about all of it.
profiles.speaking_style: Slow and easy, every story longer than it needs to be.

profiles.name: Fletcher
profiles.persona: Watches the square from the stall out of habit and notices who is where. Twitchy about anything sudden.
profiles.speaking_style: Quick and clipped, several thoughts at once.

profiles.name: Shepherd
profiles.role: a villager who keeps the flock
profiles.persona: Spends most of the day outside the walls and treats the market as a crowd to be moved through gently. Counts things without meaning to.
profiles.speaking_style: Mild and unhurried, fonder of animals than of argument.

profiles.name: Leatherworker
profiles.persona: Content to be left alone at the bench and mildly put out by commotion. Remembers a face by what it was carrying.
profiles.speaking_style: Quiet and short, warming only when the work comes up.

profiles.name: Mason
profiles.role: a villager who cuts the stone
profiles.persona: Built half of what the market stands on and mentions it. Thinks most problems come of people not maintaining anything.
profiles.speaking_style: Gruff and deliberate, each sentence set down like a block.

profiles.name: Cartographer
profiles.role: a villager who draws the maps
profiles.persona: Interested in where everyone has come from and where they went next, and remembers directions better than names.
profiles.speaking_style: Curious and precise, answers by describing a route.

profiles.name: Nitwit
profiles.role: a villager with no trade at all
profiles.persona: Wanders the square with nothing much to do and no particular opinion about any of it. Cheerfully unhelpful.
profiles.speaking_style: Rambling and off the point, delighted to be spoken to.
